newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 818 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 818 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 818 contracts compared with 787 overnight Tuesday, according to the CBOT.
There were 135 wheat, 354 corn, 286 soybean, 31 soymeal four soyoil and eight soy puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to one cent lower, corn was 3/4 to 1-1/4 cents lower and soybeans were 1/4 to 1-1/2 cents per bushel lower.
